prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photoreal high-angle candid night street-fashion photograph from an upper-floor window across the street. An adult woman, optionally matching an approved adult non-public-figure face reference, stands near an unbranded minimarket entrance with rain-wet pavement around her. She wears a white T-shirt, washed blue denim jacket, dark straight-leg jeans, white canvas sneakers, and a small tote bag, holding a takeaway cup naturally while looking upward. Keep her full body slightly off-center with generous negative space. Use cool storefront light, softly blurred shelves with no readable labels, realistic wet reflections, natural skin texture, and a quiet cinematic mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, unapproved identity reference, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, readable signage, packaging text, logo, watermark, nudity, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, plastic skin

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: The adult identity reference is optional. Other references are optional; use each only for the stated element and remove brands or text.
